`TotalPremium` reflects pricing or premium level. If influential, the model is using premium adequacy as a signal for expected claim severity.

`AnnualIncome` captures customer profile information. Interpret this carefully alongside fairness, regulation, and other exposure differences.
`Deductible` captures policy design. Influence here may reflect coverage level, customer risk selection, or incentives to claim.
